mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings are likely to improve.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX returns are negative over the 20-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE suggests labor market weakness, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns as economic growth may slow.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: UNRATE increases but SPX returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE indicate a potential economic slowdown, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns due to expected policy easing.
failure_condition: The combination of low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE does not result in positive SPX returns in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in INDPRO during an economic expansion suggests increased productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is positive but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in HOUST indicates reduced housing demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: HOUST declines but SPX returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS rates encourage borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains low but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in both PAYEMS and RSAFS indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS and RSAFS grow but SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High FEDFUNDS during a tightening cycle may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as borrowing costs increase.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains high but SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
